correctness.rationale: I=span(b_i=e_i−e_(i+4)) is exactly the right annihilator, hence characteristic, and B/I≈Z[R4] whose affine quotient automorphism group has 8 elements. A quotient-trivial map has e_i↦e_i+δ_i∈e_i+I; multiplicativity reduces to δ_(2j−i)=T_jδ_i. T_0²=T_1²=1 and T_0T_1=−T_1T_0 determine the plus-eigenspace choices δ0,δ1 and force the remaining δi, giving all 4 integral parameters. The induced U on I has det U=[(2a+1)(2c+1)+8bd]², so integral bijectivity is exactly the displayed norm-one criterion. Affine P,Q generate the eight quotient lifts, giving unique normal form; faithfulness of restriction uses distinct right operators. Choosing a=c=d=0, b=n gives distinct square-zero unipotent shears. Independent integer checks covered all 64 basis multiplication identities for 625 quadruples, 32 lifts and determinant identities; infinite criterion follows from the algebraic proof, not the finite sample.
